verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents running offline evaluations on curated datasets during development to compare versions and catch regressions, executed as experiments, which is the core of pre-deployment eval testing. Nothing in the evidence shows CI integration or blocking a deployment on eval results. missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration (e.g. a pytest or GitHub Actions workflow), pass/fail thresholds or exit codes to gate deployments, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results

citations.quote: Run evaluations on curated datasets during development to compare versions, benchmark performance, and catch regressions.
Execute your application on the dataset to create an experiment.
Add real traces to a dataset so a failure you saw once becomes a test you run every time.
